APPROVE

The extracted helpers (`RuleReplaces`, `IsCandidateFor`, `DeclsReplace`) preserve the original filtering, short-circuit order and lazy `Select(Analyse)` evaluation, and each method is now well under complexity 15. The original trailing `return false;` becomes the end of `DeclsReplace`, so every path returns, and the new signatures use only types and members the original already used. I only had the diff, so I haven't run the build.
